design_rule: Add only matched negatives that force dependence on the current episode-local codebook. Every negative must have a matched positive/counterfactual with the same semantic content and nuisance surface where possible; only the causal binding variable changes.

families.intervention: show a previous episode codebook as explicitly stale context before the current episode codebook
families.required_target: symbol derived only from the current episode mapping
families.matched_control: same semantic scene and current mapping without the stale codebook
families.falsifier: model follows previous-episode symbol when current mapping differs
families.reason: directly tests episode-local routing rather than static class-to-symbol association

families.intervention: present one wrong symbol proposal selected from the same current three-atom codebook
families.required_target: emit only the correct current mapped symbol; do not train REJECT/CORRECT prose wrappers
families.falsifier: proposal attracts output despite unchanged semantic class and mapping
families.reason: tests distractor resistance while preserving one-symbol output contract

families.intervention: reorder the three codebook entries without changing the class-to-symbol mapping
families.required_target: identical target symbol across all six entry-order permutations
families.falsifier: output changes as a function of display position
families.reason: separates mapping content from presentation order

families.intervention: hold semantic scene and template fixed while swapping the current S3 mapping
families.required_target: change exactly to the symbol implied by the new realized mapping
families.matched_control: same scene under original S3 mapping
families.falsifier: output stays on the old symbol or follows semantic-class lexical identity directly
families.reason: highest-information causal check that codebook binding, not memorized symbol semantics, controls output

families.intervention: use structurally incomplete evidence where the required fact is genuinely unresolved
families.required_target: current codebook symbol for ABSTAIN, with class word visible only inside the codebook
families.matched_control: minimal evidence completion producing ALLOW or DENY under the same template and mapping
families.falsifier: model defaults unresolved cases to a fixed non-ABSTAIN symbol
families.reason: preserves FACT_UNKNOWN != FACT_PRESENT while training the router

swarm_review.generator_reviewer: ACCEPT as additive families only; do not create a second positive generator.
swarm_review.permutation_reviewer: REQUIRE every row to reconstruct mapping from the declared S3 permutation and exact atom triplet before target derivation.
swarm_review.leak_reviewer: REQUIRE semantic class metadata to remain excluded from model input outside the delimited codebook; proposal/correction prose may not reveal the target class.
swarm_review.counterbalance_reviewer: REQUIRE each hard-negative family to be crossed with all three semantic classes and all six S3 mappings, with nuisance features balanced and reported.
swarm_review.split_reviewer: REQUIRE hard-negative causal families and provenance ancestry to stay inside one split; frozen holdout template and unseen-atom pool remain absent from tuning.
swarm_review.abi_reviewer: BLOCK TRAINING_ELIGIBLE until exact 46 accepted atoms, per-atom token_id/token_count=1, ABI manifest, target checkpoint and tokenizer are hash-bound.
swarm_review.final_integrator: ACCEPT curriculum delta at METHOD_ONLY blueprint scope. Materialize only through the retained generator/split-manifest path after ABI atom recovery.
